headline: Windows veteran's Task Manager now runs on Mac and Linux
summary: Veteran developer Dave W. Plummer has released TMOG, a revamped Task Manager app that works natively across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
details: Legendary Windows developer Dave W. Plummer, the mind behind the original Task Manager from Windows NT 4.0, has released his latest project: TMOG (Task Manager OG). This revamped utility was developed by feeding Claude "a 107-page spec."
TMOG is not just for modern Windows 11 systems; it also runs natively on macOS and Linux. Plummer developed the app while waiting in the hospital with his son, utilizing spare time to code.

The project began as an argument about whether Microsoft Word could be 'vibe coded' today. Plummer decided to focus on a project he knows intimately, Task Manager, and used a 107-page specification fed to Claude Code to create the initial app.

The resulting TMOG app can animate everything at 60 Hz, offers extensive visual customization options, and includes retro-flavored presets. The initial versions were generated quickly, with fine-tuning beginning afterward.
The latest beta version available is 0.1.1 across all supported platforms. Plummer is actively responding to user feedback and addressing remaining 'vibe-coding flaws' as the project progresses.
